response.overview: # Scarsfield (2015)  **By MiRRoRMaN & FoChainz**  **Rating: PG-31** — no, this is not a typo. You have been warned.  *Scarsfield* is a dark psychological journey into the fractured mind of Jon, a Vietnam veteran haunted by the terrible things he has seen and done. To escape his memories, Jon creates an alternate persona within his own mind: Scarsfield.  But Scarsfield doesn't want to let Jon forget. Instead, he forces him to confront the horrors he has buried, dragging him through disturbing flashbacks, psychedelic trips, and increasingly blurred lines between reality and nightmare.  Until Jon finally realizes the truth:  **The horrors didn't stay in Vietnam. They followed him home.**  **BE WARNED:** Contains real and simulated gore, dead bodies, drug use, sex, mutilation, rape, suicide, murder, psychedelic imagery, strong language and EVP phenomena.  May cause nightmares, loss of bowel control and/or seizures.  **Not for the faint of heart.**
response.title: Scarsfield
